headline: IMF Lifts World Growth Outlook
what: The IMF raised its 2026 world-growth outlook slightly and warned about debt and heavy AI investment.
context: It expects global inflation at 4.7% and China to grow 4.5% this year.
why_it_matters: Faster activity can help U.S. exporters, while debt and concentrated spending add market risk.

headline: Korean and Japanese Stocks Slide
what: South Korea's KOSPI fell 5.5% and Japan's Nikkei 225 lost 1.8% as chip shares declined.
context: Reports of progress by Chinese memory-chip makers challenged established producers.
why_it_matters: Asian markets offer an early read on supply and demand for parts used by U.S. technology companies.

headline: Visa Gets China Market Opening
what: China approved Visa to prepare a domestic card-clearing business in a vast payments market.
context: Visa has one year to finish the setup before clearing local transactions.
why_it_matters: The opening could add U.S. revenue and test commercial ties during wider tensions.
